        // Check for game over

          endGame();
          return;
        }

        // Check for win condition

          endGame();
          return;
        }

        // Update UI
        updateUI();

        // Request next frame
        requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      };

      loop();
    }

    // Update game state
    function updateGame() {
      // Move player
      movePlayer();

      // Update enemies
      updateEnemies();

      // Update AI
      updateAI();

      // Check for collisions
      checkCollisions();
    }

    // Move player
    function movePlayer() {
      // Basic movement
      game.player.x += 1;
      game.player.y += 1;
    }

    // Update enemies
    function updateEnemies() {
      // Basic enemy movement
      for (let i = 0; i < game.enemies.length; i++) {
        game.enemies[i].x += 1;
